references.text: Parallel text in Chronicles listing the same Levitical cities from the tribe of Asher, including Mishal and Abdon with their pasturelands.
Mishal is mentioned as a city in the territory of the tribe of Asher when the land is distributed.
Abdon is mentioned as a city in the territory of the tribe of Asher in the distribution of the land.
Introduction to the section on Levitical cities from the tribe of Asher, setting the context for verse 30.
